label: Feature Map
description: One hub (the product) and what it connects to -- integrations, features, channels -- set round it on an ellipse. The hub lands, connectors draw out one by one, each node lights as its line arrives, then signal pulses run hub -> nodes. 'Works with HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack...' or 'one agent, every channel'. 3-12 nodes.

hub.label: The centre: {label, logo (image URL)} or a plain string

nodes.label: Nodes: {label, sub (small line), logo (image URL), icon (a letter/emoji when no logo)} or strings

pulses.label: Signal dots running out along the lines once built (default true)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
